funding.name: TEXAS Grant
funding.provides: Need-based state grant for eligible students attending General Academic Teaching Institutions in Texas.
funding.eligibility: Eligible students attending General Academic Teaching Institutions (GATIs), excluding Lamar State College-Orange and Port Arthur (per page).

funding.name: Texas Workforce Pell (WFP) Program
funding.provides: Expands federal Pell aid to short-term, high-value workforce training programs aligned with Texas economic priorities.
funding.how_to_apply: FAFSA, then enrollment in an approved WFP program (per page). Page status: pending federal implementation.

funding.name: Financial Aid for Swift Transfer (FAST)
funding.provides: Funds public institutions to offer dual credit courses at no cost to educationally disadvantaged students.
funding.eligibility: Students eligible for the national free/reduced-price lunch program in the enrollment year or any of the four prior school years (per page).

funding.name: TRUE Grant (Texas Reskilling and Upskilling through Education)
funding.provides: Competitive grants to public colleges to create or expand short-term career training (under six months) in high-demand occupations, developed with employers and workforce boards.

funding.name: TWC Registered Apprenticeship Training Programs
funding.provides: Registered apprenticeship: learn a skilled trade on the job while getting paid, with related classroom instruction.

funding.name: WIOA Eligible Training Providers and Individual Training Accounts (Texas)
funding.provider: Texas Workforce Commission / Local Workforce Development Boards
funding.provides: WIOA-funded Individual Training Accounts let local boards pay for training at statewide Eligible Training Providers for adult and dislocated worker participants.
funding.how_to_apply: Contact your local Workforce Solutions Office (per TWC job training page).

funding.name: Skills for Small Business
funding.provides: Grant supporting training of new and incumbent employees at businesses with fewer than 100 employees.
funding.eligibility: Businesses with fewer than 100 employees (per page).
funding.amount: Up to $2 million available across the program (per page)

funding.name: Skills Development Fund
funding.provides: Fund for businesses that want to train new workers or upgrade the skills of current ones.
